nodes.label: Lunidex Mobile App (@primedex/mobile)
nodes.rationale: The app reuses shared core business logic, writes its UI for mobile, and remains usable locally without cloud configuration.

nodes.label: Metro Workspace Resolution
nodes.rationale: Metro must watch the repository root and resolve both the app and hoisted workspace dependencies to preserve monorepo resolution.

nodes.label: Mobile UI Conventions
nodes.rationale: Screens should work across device sizes and preserve accessibility, platform-appropriate touch targets, and established Expo components.

nodes.label: Native Compatibility Identifiers
nodes.rationale: Keep the Expo slug and scheme, bundle and package identifiers, deep links, and package names stable because published builds and persisted data depend on them.

nodes.label: Platform Adapter Boundary
nodes.rationale: Platform-specific behavior belongs in shared-core adapters so business logic stays platform-neutral and does not need Platform.OS branches.
